description: Composite two-panel figure pairing orientation (EBSD-type) recrystallized-grain maps with {110} pole figures at two strain rates, from hot-torsion tests on Fe–8% Al. (a), labelled "a. ε̇ = 5 s⁻¹", is a tall narrow map in which recrystallized grains are coloured solid blue against a white (deformed/unindexed) matrix; a faint red boundary trace runs near its base and a scale bar sits at the lower left with no legible length. To its right is a {110} pole figure — a stereographic circle with horizontal and vertical diameter lines and contoured intensity levels — annotated "(110)" and "max = 1.77". (b), labelled "b. ε̇ = 10 s⁻¹", shows three vertically stacked map strips of the same blue-grain/white-matrix type, plus a matching {110} pole figure annotated "(110)" and "max = 1.66". Both pole figures show broad, diffuse, irregular contour lobes rather than sharp isolated peaks, and the printed maxima (1.77 vs 1.66) are low; the figure therefore demonstrates that the selected recrystallized grains formed at both strain rates carry only a weak {110} texture. No axes, units, colour-scale legend or per-contour Miller indices are printed.

subfigures.description: Left: tall narrow recrystallization map with solid blue grains in a white matrix, a faint red trace line near the base and an unreadable scale bar at bottom left; labelled 'a. ε̇ = 5 s⁻¹'. Right: a {110} pole figure drawn as a stereographic circle with cross-hairs and contour lines, labelled '(110)' and 'max = 1.77'.

Left: three vertically stacked map strips of the same type (blue grains in white matrix, small scale bar, green/black fragments at strip corners); labelled 'b. ε̇ = 10 s⁻¹'. Right: a matching {110} pole figure with cross-hairs and contours, labelled '(110)' and 'max = 1.66'.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is labelled 'a. ε̇ = 5 s⁻¹' and panel (b) is labelled 'b. ε̇ = 10 s⁻¹', identifying the two hot-torsion strain rates compared.
In both panels the recrystallized grains are rendered in solid blue inside a white matrix on narrow vertical map strips.
Both pole figures are annotated '(110)' (printed without braces), i.e. {1 1 0} pole figures drawn as stereographic circles with horizontal and vertical diameter lines and contour lines.
The pole figure of panel (a) carries the printed text 'max = 1.77' and that of panel (b) carries 'max = 1.66'.
The contour lines in both {110} pole figures form broad, diffuse, irregular lobes rather than sharp isolated intensity peaks.
Panel (b)'s map is presented as three vertically stacked strips rather than one continuous map as in panel (a).
A faint red line (boundary trace) is visible near the base of the map in panel (a), and small green/black marks appear at the corners of the strips in panel (b).
Scale bars are present at the bottom of the maps in both panels, but their lengths are not legible at the supplied resolution.
The caption states the figure shows 'Selected recrystallized grains and the associated {1 1 0} pole figures'.
The citing text states that the recrystallized grains analysed were selected on the basis of an internal misorientation below 2°, and that these selected grains are displayed in blue.
Both printed pole-figure maxima are small numbers close to 1 (1.77 and 1.66), consistent with a weak crystallographic texture of the selected recrystallized grains.

measured_quantities: pole figure maximum intensity (dimensionless, as printed 'max = ...')
recrystallized grain internal misorientation (°, threshold <2° per citing text)
